title: Double amidino-mediated multiple hydrogen-bonded Dion–Jacobson perovskites enable oriented crystallization for efficient inverted FAPbI3 solar cells and modules (642 cm2)
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,8268-8279
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE01101A, Paper
Zhiyuan Xu, Yuqin Zhou, Cheng Gong, Ke Wang, Zhihao Guo, Zhijun Li, Omar F. Mohammed, Zhigang Zang
A double amidino-based derivative, namely PhDFACl2, has been explored as a spacer for DJ 2D/3D FAPbI3-based perovskites. Champion efficiencies of 26.10%, 24.81%, and 18.20% for 0.1 cm2, 1.01 cm2, and 642 cm2 devices have been achieved.
